files.description: The complete EHI export documentation page — a single static HTML page describing CloudCraft's 170.315(b)(10) export. Contains two sections: Provider Export (bulk export workflow with 5 steps) and Patient Export Requests (FHIR R4 DocumentReference). Lists exported data types: C-CDA USCDI v3, PDFs, images, Word docs, internal correspondence. No data dictionary, schema, or API details.

Full-page browser screenshot of the B10.html page showing the rendered workflow diagram with 5 icons (patient request → admin console → select patients → download location → secure access) and both Provider Export and Patient Export Requests sections.
